lines.text: The Israelites will be like the sand of the sea, and Judah and Israel will be gathered under one leader.
The LORD says to call the brothers "My people" and to rebuke the mother, for she is not His wife.
The LORD says He will make the mother like a desert and let her die of hunger.
She will say she will return to her first husband, but she does not acknowledge that the LORD gave her grain, new wine, and oil.
The LORD will destroy her vines and fig trees and make them into a threshing floor devoured by beasts of the field.
